description: One port per login method, all serving the same frame UI from www/. Ports are published on 127.0.0.1 by docker-compose.yaml.

variants.name: none
variants.summary: No login, scripts answer 403 without a same-origin Referer.

variants.name: digest
variants.summary: HTTP Digest on every request, Unwire must reject the session.

variants.name: form
variants.summary: Login form, session cookie mock_form_session, code behind the login.

variants.name: sid
variants.summary: Login built by an imported script, session in the URL parameter sid.

variants.name: path
variants.summary: Session token as a path segment, /ui/;tok=<VALUE>/.

variants.name: bearer
variants.summary: Public code, the API needs an Authorization Bearer header.
